method: IDA 9.5 MCP, both databases; callers/callees of matched code, call-sequence alignment, masked-prologue search, skeleton diff, decompile compare. See Rebirth/Documentation/research/RE-1005-hud-renderer.md
block_rule_note: call_redirect.Install, entry_redirect and code_redirect need the patched bytes inside one aligned 16-byte block. Items marked 'CROSSES' below are found and semantically unchanged, but the mod's current install method for them will refuse in 1.005; see each note.

items.note: ME_FreeResourceBindingArray (kFreeString). Skeleton identical to 1.004 (10/10 insns); only the __chkstk rel32 differs.

TWeakPtrTS__Release. Skeleton identical. Two arrays use this address: player_two/lock_on.cpp kWeakReleaseBytes (17 bytes, 'bytes') and hud/target_views.cpp kReleaseBytes (10 bytes, 'bytes_10' = the first 10). The replaced-address check needs one length per address: make both arrays the same length, or let the table hold both.

ME_Group_ProcessStreamingFeedbackReadbacks(group). The only callee at the gate's call (below). Recompiled (prologue now saves rbx at [rsp+20h] and rcx at [rsp+8]); group fields are -8 (CS +0x260->+0x258, chunk list +0x290/+0x298 -> +0x288/+0x290). Signature void(group) unchanged. Its entry instruction crosses block 0x140BC1940, so it is no fallback for the call redirect.

ME_MainPass_CopyStreamingFeedbackToReadback(builder, scene): first 16 bytes identical; kCopyFirst=5 still a whole instruction (mov [rsp+10h],rdx). Found as the only callee at ME_RenderChunkDispatch_ViewLoop 0x141324C60+0xCC. CROSSES: the first instruction 0x14199FE6C..0x14199FE70 crosses block 0x14199FE70, so EntryRedirect refuses; the one call 0x141324D2C also crosses. Workable alternative: the 2nd instruction 0x14199FE71 (48 89 4C 24 08, mov [rsp+8],rcx) lies in one block (a CodeRedirect there, as enemy_gauges does for kByWidget).

The gate's (ME_Scene_UpdateInstanceVisibility_FromView0 = 0x140BC0E0C, called at Render_Main+0x759) call of ProcessStreamingFeedbackReadbacks; rcx=rbx=group as before. Gate skeleton 74/74 insns, the only changes are the group offsets 0x218->0x210 and 0x220->0x218. CROSSES: the call 0x140BC0ECC..0x140BC0ED0 crosses block 0x140BC0ED0, so CallRedirect::Install refuses (render thread, so InstallFromOwnThread does not fit). Alternative: a CodeRedirect on Process's 2nd instruction 0x140BC1941 (one block, rsp still at entry so the skip can return directly).

Widget render-transform apply (kApplyTransform, unnamed in 1.004; named UWidget_ApplyRenderTransform_cand). Recompiled (new prologue, more inlining) but the same function: void(UWidget*), RenderTransform at widget+0x90 (a1[18]), Slate weak pointer at a1[27..30]; 299 callers in both builds. kRenderScale 0x98 is unchanged.
TArray_TArrayQuad80__Dtor. Skeleton identical (26 insns). The text-block dtor calls it at 0x1408865D0 after lea rcx,[rbx+5A0h] (0x1408865C9).
TArray_TArrayRun52__Dtor. Skeleton identical (27 insns). Called after lea rcx,[rbx+530h] (0x140886605).

BeginInitResource_OrDirectIfRenderThread(FRenderResource*). Recompiled: IsInRenderingThread and TGraphTask SetupPrereqs are now inlined. Same behaviour: call vt+0x28 directly when on the render thread, otherwise enqueue the init command. 466 callers.
AreaMapIcon_FrameUpdate(instance rcx, DeltaTime xmm1): xmm1 is still copied at once (vmovaps xmm15,xmm1). Stack frame 0x750->0x780. Code reshuffled (offsets of the three sites below changed).

kLeaderCall: the frame function's call of Party_GetLeaderCharacterByLeaderType (new 0x1416CE5FC), no arguments, result tested at once. Inside block 0x1409B5EB0. Found by call-sequence alignment of old vs new FrameUpdate (callee position 0x12C->0x128).
kFirstControllerCall: call of UWorld__GetFirstPlayerController (matched 0x140F99D50), rcx=rbx (world) as before, result stored to the same frame slot (var_4B8). Inside block 0x1409B5F10.

hud_trace site: FrameUpdate's first call of EndUI__ProjectWorldToRootOverlay (matched 0x140BC8AB8), rcx = [rsp+var_4B8] (the controller) as before. The second site 0x1409FA4F6 -> 0x1409B9134 agrees with the matcher. CROSSES: 0x1409B810C..0x1409B8110 crosses block 0x1409B8110, so CallRedirect::Install refuses. Game thread: InstallFromOwnThread would work (diagnostic trace only).

EndCutsceneMgr_IsAnyPlaying_Types0and2: bool(), no args. The AnyEntryMatches walk is now inlined (mgr+0x628/+0x630, mask 0x10001 = types 0 and 2, actor+0x2C0 player). Prologue changed (it was B8 38 00 00 00 E8...).
AreaMapIcon_Update(holder, key, source): the first 24 bytes are identical to 1.004. Stack frame 0x120->0x140, register allocation changed; holder fields used (+0x18, +0x128) unchanged.
Party_GetLeaderCharacterByLeaderType (kLeader): the same 5-instruction wrapper (chkstk, call, mov cl,al, add rsp, tail jmp); only rel32s differ.

SEndRootOverlay__RenderToCompositeLayer(overlay): the only caller in the overlay family of all three menu-renderer calls (acquire/FindOrAdd/submit) besides the minimap/offscreen widgets. Returns at once when overlay+0x2F0 is null (kOverlayWindow 0x2F0 unchanged). Prologue changed (rdi now pushed, r15 added). Inside: renderer in rsi (was rdi), slot in r14 (was rsi).

Overlay's AcquireLayerSlot call: mov rcx,rax ; mov dl,2 ; mov rsi,rax ; call. ABI arguments (rcx renderer, dl 2) and the slot in rax are unchanged; the caller keeps renderer in rsi and slot in r14 (were rdi/rsi). Inside block 0x140B0F110.

Overlay's FindOrAddNamedLayerEntry call: rdx=[g_FName_SEndRootOverlay 0x149187480], r8=rsp+48h (rect, was rsp+40h), rcx=r14 (slot, was rsi). Three register arguments, entry in rax. Inside block 0x140B0F140.

Overlay's SubmitLayerSlot call: mov r8,r14 (slot) ; mov dl,2 ; mov rcx,rsi (renderer) ; call. Same ABI arguments (the source registers changed). Inside block 0x140B0F2F0. Preceded by the child paint call (0x140B0F2E9).

ME_Scene_ComputeRequestedMips_HiddenComponents(renderer, cmdlist, &Views[0]): called right after the gate in Render_Main (0x140C13AAB, r8=[rsi+0E0h]). Body gained a new branch (if dword_146EEE04C) ahead of the old loop; skipping the whole call is still what the mod wants. First instruction is now mov [rsp+10h],rbx (5 bytes, so kHiddenFirst=5 still fits), but it CROSSES block 0x1407838A0, so EntryRedirect refuses. Alternative: its only call 0x140C13AAB (E8 EC FD B6 FF) is inside block 0x140C13AA0, so a CallRedirect there works (args rcx/rdx/r8 as before).

AddRenderCompositeLayerDelegatePasses(module, builder, &Views, texture, context): first 16 bytes identical. Body recompiled; still one RDG pass per view. Its only caller is 0x140C1481D. Its entry instruction (5 bytes) is inside block 0x14131BB70.

EndUI__MF8_UpdateEntries (new 0x140975014) call of EndUI__MF8_IsEntryForcedTargeted_DecTimer15C(p); rcx=r15 = p (was r14), the bool is tested at once. CROSSES block 0x140975400, so CallRedirect::Install refuses. Game thread: InstallFromOwnThread works; or a CodeRedirect on kForced's 2nd instruction 0x140807751 (its only caller is this site).

UpdateEntries' call of EndUI__MF8_ProjectEntry_Targeted (matched 0x140F6F488): rcx mgr, rdx widget(r12), r8 &key, r9 &loc, [rsp+28h] halfSize (xmm3), [rsp+30h] skipLeaderClamp: the same 7-argument layout. Inside block 0x140975570. Changed after the call: the old code jumped away (jmp short); the new code goes on to test dil and call FWeakObjectPtr::Get(r15). Not an argument change.

EndUI__CollectLockOnTargets(TArray* out): kCollectBytes is 41 bytes (the frame 0x18E0 -> 0x18D0 changes bytes 27 and 32-33; the last 4 are the chkstk rel32). Still reads battle-system +0x70/+0x78 (displayed target). Callers: UpdateEntries 0x14097512A, 0x140F6F67D, 0x140F73B8D.
EndUI__MF8_IsEntryForcedTargeted_DecTimer15C(p): the same p+0x159 flag, 4 status-icon FNames (now table 0x149002F20), p+0x15C -= time step. Prologue identical apart from the chkstk rel32.

UUserWidget::SetPlayerContext(widget, ctx): copies 16 bytes to +0x248 (kWidgetWorldWeak 0x250 unchanged), then walks the WidgetTree (+0x1D8) with a lambda. Found by its unique store pattern C5 F8 10 02 C5 FA 7F 81 48 02 00 00. Changed: the prologue is now a leaf-style chkstk frame, and the walk is a single call on the tree (sub_140804CA8) instead of RootWidget plus ForWidgetAndChildren. Same effect. 7 callers in both builds.
AreaMapIconMgr__ClearAllAndDisable(instance): TWeakPtr pins now inlined; instance fields +0x10/+0x18, +0x20.., +0x70/+0x78, +0x80.., +0xD0, +0xDC unchanged. kCanvases/kMaps/kEnabled/kFlagD1 hold.

Circle skip site (SEndNaviMapCircle__OnPaint_Pool0 = 0x14130A3DC). Bytes identical, but: (1) CROSSES block 0x14130A500 (0x14130A4FF..0x14130A505), so CodeRedirect refuses. A site in one block on the same path: 0x14130A506 vmovq rdx,xmm0 (C4 E1 F9 7E C2), still before the resize, acquire, paint and submit. (2) The code after the submit (0x14130A77E) now reads [rsp+40h] (vmovss xmm7,[rsp+40h] at 0x14130A78E), which only the skipped block writes (0x14130A5A2: 1.0f from 0x145F09708). The skip must also store 1.0f to [rsp+40h] (C7 44 24 40 00 00 80 3F), besides xmm13=0 (still needed: vxorps xmm13 at 0x14130A573, used after). In 1.004 that constant was loaded from .rdata after the submit.

Circle acquire call: xor edx,edx ; mov rcx,rbx ; call AcquireLayerSlot (0x140A4796C); slot rax -> rbx and [rsp+58h] (was [rsp+68h]). Now INSIDE one block (0x14130A510), so a plain Install works (InstallFromOwnThread still accepts it).
Circle FindOrAdd call: rdx=[0x1491873A8] (FName static), r8=rbp-20h rect, rcx=rbx slot. Inside block 0x14130A550.
FEndMenuRenderer__SubmitLayerSlot(renderer, pool, slot): all 4 callers line up with 1.004's (overlay, circle, octagon, offscreen). Recompiled: the prologue is no longer mov rax,rsp form.
FEndMenuRenderer__FindOrAddNamedLayerEntry(slot, FName, FIntRect*): the same 4 callers. Recompiled: the prologue now saves r8 and pushes rsi/rdi. The 15-byte check must change.

SceneRenderer_Render_Main, slot 1 of the SE scene-renderer vtable 0x1455F6198 (set by SE_FSceneRenderer_DerivedConstructor 0x1409E9FD0, found by masked prologue). The first 16 bytes are identical. Grew 4990->5881 bytes (FSR). No direct callers: the vtable slot is the only way in. NB 0x142D00B54 has a matching 55-byte masked prologue but is a different function (called directly from 0x142CFF709, not the SE renderer vtable slot).

Render_Main's call of AddRenderCompositeLayerDelegatePasses (right after AllocCompositeLayerTargets, before RenderCompositeLayerPrimitives_PerView, as in 1.004). CROSSES block 0x140C14820, so CallRedirect::Install refuses (render thread). Alternative: EntryRedirect on the callee 0x14131BB74 (only caller is this site; first insn 48 89 5C 24 08 in one block) with the same 5-argument replacement.

EventCmd_Dispatch_BattleModeCase87 (0x1410D1670) call of EndUI__AreaMapIcon_HideAndClear (matched 0x140F6293C). Inside block 0x1410D2400. The matcher's structural 'at' (0x1410D238F) was wrong; found by the callee's xrefs.
The same event command's call of EndUI__AreaMapIcon_Enable (matched 0x140F62978). Inside block 0x1410D2410.

SEndTextBlock relayout (kRelayout, check only): SetText_RelayoutIfChanged (matched 0x1411A7EB0) calls it at the same +0x107 as in 1.004. Heavily recompiled (frame 0xA60->0x228, different prologue), so the 32-byte check changes. Text-block offsets it touches (0x2C8.., 0x530..0x568) match 1.004; the dtor still frees +0x5A0 / +0x530.

EndUI__M140_ProjectLeaderTargetIcon_FirstPC(w): 25 prologue bytes identical; UObject vtable calls +8 (0x160->0x168, 0x448->0x450, 0x468->0x470, 0x280->0x288) as expected. Its caller still tests m+0x20 and calls FWeakObjectPtr::Get(m+0x6C) (0x141150034..), so kLeaderTargetCount 0x20 / kLeaderTargetWeak 0x6C hold.

FWeakObjectPtr::IsValid: the main copy (7006 callers; 1.004 had 7092), used by EndCutsceneMgr_IsAnyPlaying on entry+8. Different codegen, same semantics (serial, index range, object, flags 0x10000000/0x20000000). Alternative: 0x140BF51CC is byte-identical to 1.004's (14 callers, a duplicate copy); its bytes match the mod's current array: 44 8B 49 04 45 33 C0 45 85 C9 74 4F 8B 01 85 C0.

TGraphTask SetupPrereqs (task, prereqs, currentThread, unlock): sets task+0x18=1, task+8=render thread (dword_146EECBB8), counts unmet prereqs, then FBaseGraphTask::PrerequisitesComplete (0x141958218), which queues via FTaskGraphInterface (qword_148F38150) vt[0]. 54 callers. The 4th argument is ignored: unlock is constant-folded to 1. The mod passes true, so this is fine. A second identical ICF copy is at 0x142DA489C (27 callers). Task layout (+8,+0xC,+0x10,+0x18,+0x20) unchanged.

The only call of MasterHUD_Tick (matched 0x140F759B0): lea rcx,[g_EndUISystem 0x149186150] ; vmovaps xmm1,xmm6 ; call. In sub_140B389C0 (named AEndGameMode__Tick530_Body_cand; the containing function changed shape). Inside block 0x140B38A60.

kRenderEntry: slot 1 of vtbl_SE_FSceneRenderer_Derived 0x1455F6198 (1.004: 0x1457A6718 + 8). It holds 0x140C13340 (SceneRenderer_Render_Main).
